sqeoh: Green Star Movement, with the help of approximately 500 volunteers, created this mosaic to celebrate the Woodlawn neighborhood and its culture. Elaborate portraits of notable figures, including Barack Obama, Michelle Obama, and singer Minnie Riperton are shaped out of tile. Photographs embedded in the material memorialize other former residents—including Emmett Till and Muhammad Ali. Further highlighting Woodlawn’s rich history, imagery from the front page of the Chicago Crusader, a newspaper headquartered in the neighborhood, is prominently displayed within the mosaic.
3zg55: As part of the 2024 Together We Heal project (DCASE), Mandala Arts, artist Indira Freitas Johnson, engaged residents of Rogers Park in exploring the meaning of 'community' through the process of mural making. Through a month-long process in May 2024, participants identified words, symbols and colors to represent the spirit of Devon Avenue and Rogers Park and paint it onto the exterior wall of the Republic Bank of Chicago. Participants met at the Hamdard Health Alliance for weekly meetings and become part of Mandala's Devon Community Advisory Council, which was set up to reflect the needs and desires of the people of Devon through art and culture. The project marked the finale of the sixth edition of the Mandala Makers Festival, an annual program to bring art into the public spaces of Devon.
